title: CR-C3-042 — Invoicing full (delete)
preconds: Permissions (counted): Customer V + WO V + Vendor and Order Management V + Invoicing V+E+D. Auto-gate forced ON (not counted): See Fin + AP/AR. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.
  2. Assign the role to a test user and log in.
  3. Exercise each capability in Expected Result and confirm it succeeds (and that gated pricing is hidden where noted).
expected:
User CAN: Create invoices; process payments; deposits; send to terminal; delete payments (incl customer payments); void transactions; delete a Part Sale return

Risk / Rationale: Positive capability check — confirms this combination grants exactly the listed actions and nothing gated leaks. See Flag / Note.
Spec Ref: §1h
Flag / Note: \u26a0 Invoicing Delete force-enables Manage AP/AR (gate #2, 6/28) and See Financial (gate #1)
